For our client, we are looking for motivated Order Pickers to join a modern logistics team. Experience is welcome, but if you are motivated and willing to learn, we would also like to meet you. 
As an Order Picker, you play an important role in the warehouse. Every day you make sure customer orders are picked correctly and prepared for delivery. Accuracy is important because customers depend on receiving the right products. 
Your daily tasks include: - Picking orders using a handheld scanner; - Checking products for quality and quantity; - Packing and preparing orders for shipment; - Making sure labels and orders are correct; - Keeping your workplace clean, safe, and organised; - Working together with your team to meet daily targets. 
The work is active, so you'll be on your feet for most of the day. If you enjoy staying busy instead of sitting behind a desk, this job is a great fit.

Working on Sundays and public holidays may also be part of the schedule; - Has experience with order picking or a handheld scanner (preferred, but not required).
